scope: Independent read-only validation-harness source review. No additional production or test execution.

resolutions.resolution: Assert literal requested SET/RAMP structure before interpreting model commands.
Compute independent requested timeline from ramp/hold constants and compare committed GUI pulse.t.
Require exact shots*segment_count+1 AWG count and validate the sole startup zero SET before removal.

additional_checks: Independent literal matrix @ voltage reference and separate documented DAC/increment quantization.
Fine command parser checks plateau/tail mode, gain, address, loaded envelope active/zero samples and total requested sample count. This is digital command/memory evidence, not a measured waveform.
RF command start offset is compared to the corresponding AWG anchor with the explicit 30-clock requested offset.
Current Qt inputs enter normal MainWindow argument builder, current production compiler and tProcessor instruction model.
Per-case child process isolation and unique attempt folders preserve initial failures. Parent must inspect both result.status and exit_code, not exit_code alone.

observed_limitations.name: Exact zero-ramp SET-only GUI construction
observed_limitations.detail: Mixed-matrix zero-ramp edit reached production invalid-edit QMessageBox path (DCWaveform_Generator.py:2190) and produced a Windows access violation. Identity variant was not executed because the same requested zero-time transition cannot be represented by the current strict-increasing PulseSequence. Neither case is PASS; no claim that every digital SET feature is unsupported.

observed_limitations.name: Cross-window deferred Qt callback
observed_limitations.detail: The earlier multi-window process executed a pending production scroll callback after its QScrollArea was deleted (line2450). The final harness isolates each case in a fresh process. This does not establish that production callback has been fixed.

observed_limitations.name: RF field entry
observed_limitations.detail: Earlier simulated input left default frequency/duration values unchanged. Final helper reveals the tab, scrolls to the widget, verifies enabled/visible/focus, and enables sweep before typing bounds. Reviewed four-case retry produced three passes and one intended bound rejection, all exit0.

observed_limitations.name: Layer boundaries
observed_limitations.detail: No live Run worker, board upload, scope, analog timing/frequency, ADC/FIR acquisition or exact zero-offset AWG/RF simultaneity. Coarse RTL matrix oracle independently checks initial SET targets; other raw checks derive from compiler commands. Fine RTL width is independent from requested sample counts, while starts use executed model command cycles.

final_batch_status: Not asserted here: final 38-case batch still running at source-review freeze; root/GUI owner must reconcile final counts and exits.
